text:
alex: quick sync - we still see rare duplicates when the finalizer and the reconciler both accept an inflight token during a partition. repro: client -> handshake_token(T=tn123) -> finalizer writes checkpoint_frame -> reconcile replays token -> both write ledger row.

priya: handshake_token is not globally stable for retries in some SDKs. relying on it for dedupe is brittle.

dan: proposal: introduce a deterministic `reconcile_key` derived from the final output digest + tenant id. make the `handshake_token` ephemeral and local-only.

alex: reconcile_key = hex(trunc_sha256(tenant||output_digest||window_epoch)). ledger upserts by (reconcile_key, checkpoint_frame_epoch). that way retries that reissue handshake_token won't duplicate.

priya: how do we keep realtime "pending" UI then? dashboards read sidecar `/internal/metering/pending_by_epoch` (prom scrape). we'll keep a short-lived epoch index (48h) for joins.

finance: need to ensure reporting & refunds work: backfills must carry `source_batch_id` and `source_window_ts`. reconcile_key should be stable for backfills too.

ops-bot: branch "metering/reconcile-key-handshake" created, CI queued.

dan: Add `origin_hint` enum (live|repair|backfill) to reconcile events. include `checkpoint_frame` with small fingerprints instead of full payload to reduce payload size.

alex: migration plan: mirror mode for 21 days where we emit legacy (handshake_token events + ledger writes) AND new reconcile_event with header `x-metering-mirror:true`. consumers switch to reconcile_event joins keyed on reconcile_key. after mirror, flip per-tenant.

priya: tests: wrote `./tools/sim_reconcile.py --seed 99 --races 50k` that reproduces the partition+retry dupe. will add invariants: no duplicate ledger row for same reconcile_key within epoch window.

dan: compaction: keep reconcile_key mapping compact in TTL store 7d for audits; full archive in s3 for 90d.

finance: costs look fine; small bytes/event. remind ops to add reconciliation checks to month-end ledger QA.

alex: i'll draft RFC follow-up w/ event schema, sample payloads, mirror checklist, canary steps, and rollback playbook. pinging @priya @dan for reviews.

ops-bot: staging canary scheduled in 15m.

priya: good plan. LGTM.

dan: :thumbsup:
